name: @milkyway-666/tempo
description: Tempo — a personal, chat-driven work tracker. Narrate your work to an agent; it appends an event log and derives your board, time, and plans. Runs as a local MCP server for Claude Code.

scripts.version: npm run changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:patch: npm version patch -m "release: v%s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.deploy:minor: npm version minor -m "release: v%s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.deploy:major: npm version major -m "release: v%s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
